Game Overview

In KULI, the core idea is straightforward: brace yourself for the thrill of survival in KULI. Strategize and construct defenses by day, then unleash your firepower on the undead by night. Battle through gripping mini-challenges, harness your building skills, and stay alive in the relentless zombie apocalypse. Can you outlast the night?
